claims.location: comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], comment[ms2 mass analyzer], comment[ms1 scan range] all rows
claims.evidence: Preprint Methods: Q Exactive HF; "Full scans (MS1) were acquired over a mass-to-charge (m/z) range of 350-1600 at a resolution of 120,000"; precursors "fragmented with a normalised collision energy (NCE) of 28"; "MS2 spectra were acquired at a resolution of 30,000". NCE fragmentation on Q Exactive HF is HCD and resolution-specified MS2 is Orbitrap.
PRIDE title describes degraded milk whey; the preprint uses bovine beta-lactoglobulin (UniProt P02754), a milk whey protein. Blanks are not applicable.

PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "All fractions were heated (70C) at pH 7 for 12 hrs". Methods: all solutions were pH 7 and samples and method blanks were incubated at 70 °C in a heating block for 12 hours.

Characteristic column matching the additive factor (BLG only, glucose, octanoic acid, glucose and octanoic acid).

limitations: The blank incubation time is not identified by the three RAW filenames, so not available is used.
The preprint is not peer reviewed; its Methods are used for experimental design, cross-checked against PRIDE file names.
Search parameters are reported in the linked preprint Methods; no standalone parameter file is deposited. PSM output corroborates variable mass shifts but not fixed carbamidomethyl C or tolerances.
HCD and Orbitrap MS2 analyzer are inferred from the Q Exactive HF and the NCE/resolution wording, not literal labels.
